description: All natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes for the classy minimalist
readme:
# Rosé Pine

All natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes: **Rosé Pine**, Rosé Pine Moon (dark) and Rosé Pine Dawn (light), each also without italics. After installing, reload the window and pick a theme with `Preferences: Color Theme` (Ctrl+K Ctrl+T), or set `"workbench.colorTheme": "Rosé Pine"` in settings.json.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
